posts.author: rtehrani
posts.text:
NCC Group recorded 894 ransomware cases in July, marking a 22% increase from June and the highest monthly volume observed so far in 2026. The figures suggest that ransomware operations are becoming faster and more scalable as criminals incorporate artificial intelligence into established attack methods.

North American organisations represented 41% of recorded attacks, while European targets accounted for another 26% (source). Together, those regions made up more than two-thirds of NCC Group’s July cases, underlining the sustained pressure on businesses operating in large, digitally connected markets.

The emergence of autonomous AI agents illustrates how that pressure is changing. Rather than simply helping criminals write more convincing emails, agentic systems can support multiple stages of an operation, including reconnaissance, data identification, and the preparation of targeted malicious content.

Ransomware has become an industrial operation. Criminal groups divide work among initial-access brokers, malware developers, infrastructure operators, and negotiators. AI reduces the time and expertise needed for several of these functions, allowing smaller groups to behave more like mature cybercrime businesses.

“AI is changing the speed and scale of cyber attacks. It’s allowing attackers to automate more of what they do, operate at greater scale and create increasingly convincing phishing, social engineering and other malicious content,” said the vice-president of cyber intelligence and response at NCC Group. https://t.co/747DlKfZjP

posts.author: ctomservice
posts.text:
🚨 超级叙事雷达出现一个新的硬确认信号：

Tokenized Stocks 的重点正在从“资产有没有上链”，转向“真正股权 + 链上结算 + 衍生品市场”。这一级别值得记录。

截至 2026 年 8 月 26 日，最新机构市场统计显示，Tokenized Equities 的 2026 YTD 永续合约成交量已经超过 $590B，相比 2025 全年约 $16B 出现数量级跃升；链上现货成交也已经超过 $88B，全年按当前速度可能突破 $145B。与此同时，链上股票存量市值却只有约 $2.1B，而全球股票市场约 $151.9T。换句话说，交易需求已经远远跑在资产存量前面。

这进一步验证了我们前面从你那份《The State of Tokenized Stocks》得到的判断：

Tokenized Stocks 真正的大市场很可能不只是 Spot，而是 Perps + Collateral + Lending + Hedging + Vault + Settlement。

🔴 更重要的新变化：真正“原生股票”开始出现

Bullish 官方确认，其 NYSE 上市股票 BLSH 已经把完整 cap table 搬到 Solana，由 SEC 注册 transfer agent Equiniti 管理；8 月 12 日又正式出现 BLSH Token 在受 GFSC 监管的 Bullish Exchange 上以美元稳定币交易并近实时结算。

这不是合成股票。

持有者对应的是真实股份所有权，链上转移会同步更新官方 shareholder register，拥有与传统股东相同的法律地位。

所以现在 Tokenized Stocks 已经明显分成三类：

① Issuer-sponsored：真实股权 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
公司自己发行，股东名册直接连接链上。

② Custodian-backed：托管映射股权

③ Synthetic：只追踪股价，没有真正股票所有权

下一轮资本真正愿意大量进入的，很可能不是“链上有个 AAPLx 就算 RWA”，而是：

真实证券权利
→ Transfer Agent
→ 链上登记
→ Stablecoin DvP
→ 即时 Settlement
→ Collateral
→ Lending / Perps
→ Vault / Agent Asset Management

这才是完整 Onchain Capital Markets。

⸻

🎯 对我们现有标的的影响

SOL：🔴 产业位置继续增强。 BLSH 是目前非常典型的 issuer-sponsored 原生股权案例，而且 cap table 直接建在 Solana；但这仍然属于网络采用利好，不等于 SOL Token 收入同比例增长。

HYPE：🟠→🔴 值得继续提高权重。 因为 $590B 这种数据进一步证明，Tokenized Equities 最大的当前需求之一恰恰是 Perps。如果 Hyperliquid 真正吃到股票永续/现货/抵押交易量，它的“全球 24/7 多资产交易所”逻辑会明显增强；但必须等实际 Volume + Fees 验证，不能仅凭行业总量推导 HYPE 收益。

ZRO：🔴 逻辑再被强化，但尚未兑现。 

所以这轮我对母叙事的判断进一步提高：

Onchain Capital Markets 已经不是单纯的“RWA Tokenization”。市场正在向“全球证券交易、清算、结算基础设施重构”迁移。

而真正值得我们找的投资标的，是能从这 $590B→未来万亿美元级交易流 中稳定收取 Trading Fee、Oracle Fee、Settlement Fee、Lending Fee、Vault Fee，并且这些收入最终能够回流 Token 的协议。

影响强度：4.5/5 🔴
母叙事：继续强化
本轮最值得继续深挖：HYPE / ZRO / SOL，以及承担 Oracle、Collateral、Lending、Vault 的基础设施。
